title: TEMPO: Makespan-Aware Expert-Parallel Load Balancing Across Memory- and Compute-Bound Regimes
abstract: arXiv:2608.13057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In expert-parallel (EP) MoE serving, every layer synchronizes at the slowest GPU. Dispatchers balance token counts (EPLB, LPLB, UltraEP) or activated-expert counts (METRO), assuming expert time is linear in one. Measurements on two datacenter GPU generations show it is neither: below $\nstar\!\approx\!156$--$168$ tokens, HBM weight streaming dominates---cost attaches to \emph{activated replicas}, not tokens; above it, grouped GEMM rounds tokens to 128-tile $M$-tiles, so \emph{splitting} an expert adds padded compute. A max-affine profile $t=\max(a+bG,\,c+\beta N)$ captures both regimes. Realistic decode batches hold hot experts in the linear regime and cold in the flat \emph{simultaneously}; recorded batches show proxy dispatches differ by $1.4$--$1.6\times$ in modeled block time (p95 up to $1.7\times$), and \emph{which} proxy wins flips with the regime. We formalize per-batch dispatch as a fixed-charge makespan problem---NP-hard on tw

translated_title: TEMPO：面向内存受限与计算受限场景的专家并行负载均衡，以完成时间为导向
translated_abstract: 在专家并行（EP）MoE服务中，每一层同步以最慢的GPU为准。调度器平衡令牌数量（EPLB、LPLB、UltraEP）或激活专家数量（METRO），假设专家时间与其中一个因素呈线性关系。对两代数据中心GPU的测量显示，事实并非如此：当令牌数低于$\nstar\!\approx\!156$--$168$时，HBM权重流传输占主导地位——开销与激活副本相关，而非令牌；高于此阈值时，分组GEMM将令牌四舍五入为128块的$M$-tile，因此拆分专家会增加填充计算。一个最大仿射配置文件$t=\max(a+bG,\,c+\beta N)$捕捉了这两种机制。现实中的解码批次同时将热门专家保持在线性机制，冷门专家保持在平坦机制；记录批次显示，代理调度在建模块时间上差异达$1.4$--$1.6$倍（p95最高达$1.7$倍），且哪个代理获胜会随机制而翻转。我们将每批次调度形式化为一个固定费用完成时间问题——在二值约束下为NP难问题。
tldr: 本文提出TEMPO，一种面向专家并行MoE的负载均衡方法，通过建模内存和计算双重机制，解决令牌调度中完成时间优化问题，显著提升GPU利用率。
en_tdlr: TEMPO proposes a makespan-aware load balancing method for expert-parallel MoE, modeling memory- and compute-bound regimes to optimize token dispatch and improve GPU utilization.
